digest_method: Sorted SKILL.md plus references/*.md; hash each relative path, NUL byte, UTF-8 content with trailing whitespace normalized to one newline.
model_metadata: Inherited harness model/configuration; no explicit overrides. Exact model identifier and sampling parameters were not captured.
blinding: A/B/C labels randomized separately per case. Both judges were given only original requests, notes and anonymous outputs. Mapping revealed after both completed.
source_data: All research briefs are synthetic and public-safe. No unpublished user manuscript was used.
evaluation_order: Both original writers ran before runtime revision; revised writer ran after runtime snapshot was frozen; both judges ran afterward.
limits: One sample per condition/case, three cases, no statistical inference.
Same harness/model family; judges are agents, not human acceptance.
Judges share the same anonymous ordering; no order-sensitivity study.
Source documentation and runtime payload changed together; no ablation isolates which component caused a preference.
Generation is not guaranteed reproducible from archived outputs; prompts, outputs and judgments are available for inspection.
